andaman.title: Andaman & Nicobar — experience the extraordinary.
andaman.lead: Islands floating in splendid isolation in the Bay of Bengal, with some of India's best diving and snorkelling.

sections.heading: Splendid isolation in the Bay of Bengal.
paras: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands sit east of the Indian mainland, and Port Blair — the gateway to these pristine islands — offers water-based activities like snorkelling, scuba diving, and sea cruises alongside a rich history and culture.
Divers get the best conditions between December and April; bird watchers should aim for the winter months.

sections.heading: Things to do in Andaman.
paras: From history at Cellular Jail to the reefs off Havelock.

cards.title: Cellular Jail
items: A three-storey British-era prison from 1906, now a National Memorial to India's freedom fighters.

cards.title: Radhanagar Beach
items: Hugged by coconut trees and tropical jungle — complete serenity for its visitors.

cards.title: Corbyn's Cove Beach
items: A coconut-palm fringed beach 6km from Port Blair, ideal for swimming and water sports.

cards.title: Limestone Caves
items: Tucked deep within mangroves and rainforest — a highly recommended addition to any itinerary.

cards.title: Scuba Diving & Snorkelling
items: One of the densest coral reef ecosystems around — soft and hard corals, and a huge variety of fish.

cards.title: Mount Harriet National Park
items: Unmatched flora and fauna, with Port Blair visible from the peak.

sections.heading: Port Blair, Havelock & Neil Island packages.
paras: Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.

bali.title: Bali — an Indonesian paradise that feels like a fantasy.
bali.lead: Temples wrapped in jungle, rice terraces at dawn, and sunsets over Uluwatu's cliffs. Whatever kind of holiday you're picturing, Bali has a version of it.

sections.heading: An ideal retreat for beaches, temples & rice terraces.
paras: Adventurous, spiritual, or purely lazy-by-the-pool — Bali flexes to whatever holiday you're after. It's home to the coral reefs of Tulamben, the mountain peaks of Kintamani, the buzz of Seminyak and Kuta, and the quieter, traditional village life of Ubud.
Between the sunrises over Mount Batur and the sunsets at Uluwatu, it's a destination that's hard to leave once you've landed.

sections.heading: Things to do in Bali.
paras: The tours our travelers ask for most, built into every LeisureFlies Bali package.

cards.title: Nusa Penida Island Tour
items: One of the most beautiful islands in the world, reached by boat — home to the iconic Broken Beach.

cards.title: Bedugul & Tanah Lot Tour
items: Visit the exotic Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, set on a high tableland surrounded by ponds.

cards.title: Denpasar City & Bali Bounty Cruise
items: Explore Bali's architecture, then take to the ocean for snorkeling, banana boat rides, and a 44-metre water slide.

cards.title: Kintamani Volcano & Ubud Village
items: View Mount Batur and the Ubud Tegalalang rice terraces, then visit Celuk's gold & silver craft village and the Holy Spring Temple.

cards.title: Watersports & Uluwatu Temple
items: Parasailing, banana boat and jet ski rides, the roaring Water Blow at Nusa Dua, and Uluwatu's cliffside temple with Kecak fire dance.

cards.title: Ubud Art Market & Villages
items: Shop the Ubud Art Market and visit Celuk & Mas villages, known for centuries-old craft traditions.

cards.title: Ubud + Kuta — 4N/5D
items: Full day tour of watersports & Uluwatu Temple — private
Kintamani tour with Mount Batur, Cantik Coffee Plantation, Tegalalang Rice Terraces, Tukad Cepung Falls — private
Bedugul tour with Beratan Temple, Bali Botanical Garden, photo stop at Handara Gate & Twin Lake View Point — private
Return airport transfers on private basis

cards.title: Ubud + Kuta — 5N/6D
items: Nusa Penida day west tour from North Kuta hotel with lunch — SIC
Ubud tour with Alas Harum, Tegalalang Rice Terraces, Tibumana Falls — private
Full day tour of Lempuyang Temple and Amed Beach — private
Full day tour of Garuda Wisnu Kencana Cultural Park, Melasti Beach, Uluwatu Temple with Kecak Dance — private
Return airport transfers on private basis

cards.title: Ubud + Kuta — 6N/7D
items: Full day tour of watersports & Uluwatu Temple — private
Full day tour with Tanah Lot Temple, Alas Kedaton Monkey Forest, Taman Ayun Temple — private
Kintamani tour with Mount Batur, Cantik Coffee Plantation, Tegalalang Rice Terraces, Tukad Cepung Falls — private
Ubud shopping tour with Ubud Art Market, Celuk & Mas villages — private
Return airport transfers on private basis

dubai.title: Dubai — experience the extraordinary.
dubai.lead: One of the most sought-after destinations among the seven cities of the UAE — pure, unfiltered luxury.

sections.heading: What luxury actually looks like.
paras: Dubai makes you feel what luxury life literally looks like. Roaming the city in a limousine, viewing exotic building structures, is simply splendid.
Having dinner on a luxurious cruise under shining stars takes your breath away — and standing atop the world's tallest building pleases you from the bottom of your heart.

sections.heading: Things to do in Dubai.
paras: The essentials, plus what to explore beyond them.

cards.title: Dubai City Tour
items: A great short break for shopping, sunbathing, sporting events, and fine dining.

cards.title: Dhow Cruise with Dinner
items: Cruise, buffet dinner, live shows and a licensed bar — the trio's most important part.

cards.title: Desert Safari
items: Evening dune bashing on 4x4 land cruisers, sand boarding, BBQ dinner, tanura show and belly dance.

cards.title: Burj Khalifa & Dubai Mall
items: The world's tallest building — views from the 124th floor, then the Dubai Aquarium below.

cards.title: Abu Dhabi & Ferrari World
items: The Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, accommodating 40,000 worshippers, plus the world's largest Ferrari theme park.

cards.title: Aquaventure & Lost Chambers
items: The world's largest waterslide tube, and an 11-million-litre aquarium for an underwater yoga session.

sections.heading: Dubai city & Abu Dhabi combos.
paras: Every package includes daily breakfast, airport transfers, and the Dubai Trio (city tour, desert safari, dhow cruise) as standard. Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.

goa.title: Goa — India's pocket-sized paradise.
goa.lead: A kaleidoscopic blend of Indian and Portuguese cultures, sweetened with sun, sea, sand, seafood and susegad.

sections.heading: One of India's top holiday destinations, and it's easy to see why.
paras: From shopping at local markets to feasting on Goan cuisine and endless water sports, Goa is spoilt for choice. It's a kaleidoscopic blend of Indian and Portuguese cultures, wrapped in sun, sea, sand, seafood, and susegad.
North Goa brings the energy — beaches, nightlife, forts. South Goa slows it down with quieter shores and turtle-nesting beaches. Most travelers do a bit of both.

sections.heading: Things to do in Goa.
paras: A mix of North and South Goa highlights, built into every LeisureFlies Goa package.

cards.title: North Goa Beaches
items: Mandrem, Keri, Morjim, Sinquerim & Candolim — from quiet sunsets to dolphin spotting and jet skiing.

cards.title: Chapora Fort
items: Made famous by 'Dil Chahta Hai', this 1717 hill-top fort offers sweeping views over the Chapora River.

cards.title: Basilica of Bom Jesus
items: A UNESCO Heritage Site over 400 years old, home to the mummy of St. Xavier, displayed once a decade.

cards.title: Arpora Night Market
items: A shopaholic's Saturday night paradise — local handicrafts to designer garments.

cards.title: Dudhsagar Falls
items: A striking four-tiered waterfall on the Mandovi River, roughly 60km from Panaji.

cards.title: South Goa Beaches
items: Benaulim, Galgibaga (Olive Ridley turtle nesting), Agonda and Majorda — quieter, more laid-back shores.

sections.heading: North + South Goa packages.
paras: Every duration is fully customizable around your preferred mix of North and South Goa. Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.

himachal.title: Himachal — the land of gods.
himachal.lead: Snow-laden peaks, ancient temples, and hill stations that have drawn travelers for generations.

sections.heading: Dev Bhoomi — the land of the gods.
paras: Himachal Pradesh sits in the Western Himalayas, earning its nickname 'Dev Bhoomi' from the sheer number of historical temples scattered across the state. Shimla, Manali, Dharamshala, Dalhousie, Chamba, Khajjiar, Kullu and Kasauli are its best-known hill stations.
It's also home to major Hindu pilgrimage sites — Naina Devi, Bajreshwari Mata, Jwala Ji, Chintpurni, Chamunda Devi, Baijnath, Bhimakali and Jakhoo temples among them.

sections.heading: Things to do in Himachal.
paras: From Shimla's colonial charm to Manali's adventure sports — the essentials of every LeisureFlies Himachal package.

cards.title: Shimla Local Sightseeing
items: Christ Church, The Mall Road, Shimla State Museum, Sankat Mochan Temple and Summer Hill.

cards.title: Kalka-Shimla Toy Train
items: A UNESCO World Heritage narrow-gauge railway — a 5.5-hour ride through deodar and pine forests.

cards.title: Kufri
items: 16km from Shimla — ski slopes, a mini zoo, and views over the Potato Research Station.

cards.title: Paragliding in Manali
items: At 2050m above sea level, Manali is a favorite for both international and domestic paragliders.

cards.title: Solang Valley
items: Parachuting, paragliding, horse riding, and zorbing — one of Himachal's most popular adventure hubs.

cards.title: Rohtang Pass
items: Open June-October, the gateway to Lahaul & Spiti — sledging, snow scooters, and the Rahala Waterfall nearby.

sections.heading: Shimla + Manali packages.
paras: Multiple durations available depending on how much of Shimla, Manali, and surrounding valleys you want to cover. Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.

kashmir.title: Kashmir — a paradise on earth.
kashmir.lead: Nature lovers flock to India's northernmost extremity for Gulmarg, Pahalgam, Sonmarg, and the houseboats of Dal Lake.

sections.heading: India's northernmost extremity, made for nature lovers.
paras: The state of Jammu & Kashmir sits mostly in the Himalayan mountains, frequently visited by adventure enthusiasts for trekking, rafting, and skiing.
Some of India's major pilgrimage centers — including the Amarnath Caves and Vaishnodevi Shrine — are situated here too.

sections.heading: Things to do in Kashmir.
paras: From Srinagar's gardens to Pahalgam's saffron fields.

cards.title: Dal Lake
items: Over 15km around — Srinagar's jewel, with shikaras skiffing goods, children, and travelers across the water.

cards.title: Srinagar's Mughal Gardens
items: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, flourishing with indigenous flowers in Persian-style architecture.

cards.title: Gulmarg
items: 2,730m above sea level, with the world's second-highest gondola ride and second-longest cable car.

cards.title: Pahalgam
items: The jewel of Liddar Valley, part of Asia's only saffron-growing region — hiking, trekking and fishing.

cards.title: Sonmarg
items: 'Meadow of Gold' — a majestic glacier, dense forests, and snow-capped peaks at 2,800m.

cards.title: Aru Valley
items: 12km from Pahalgam — the base camp for trekking to Kolahoi Glacier and Tarsar Lake.

sections.heading: Srinagar + Gulmarg + Pahalgam packages.
paras: Every package includes a 1-hour shikara ride and local sightseeing across all cities. Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.

kerala.title: Kerala — God's own country.
kerala.lead: Serene beaches, tranquil backwaters, lush hill stations and exotic wildlife — a land that never stops amazing you.

sections.heading: A land of serenity.
paras: Kerala is a destination of equable climate, a long shoreline with serene beaches, tranquil backwaters, lush hill stations and exotic wildlife.
Waterfalls, sprawling plantations, paddy fields, Ayurvedic health holidays, enchanting art forms, and exotic cuisine — Kerala will make you want to explore it inch by inch.

sections.heading: Things to do in Kerala.
paras: From Munnar's tea gardens to Alleppey's backwaters.

cards.title: Kochi to Munnar Drive
items: A 4-hour scenic drive through spice plantations, past Valara and Cheeyappara Falls.

cards.title: Munnar Sightseeing
items: Eravikulam National Park (home to the Nilgiri Tahr), Anamudi Peak, and the Tata Tea Museum.

cards.title: Thekkady (Periyar)
items: A boat safari through Periyar Tiger Reserve, followed by an evening spice market walk in Kumily village.

cards.title: Alleppey Houseboats
items: A 120-metre luxury houseboat on Vembanad Lake, with traditional Kuttanadan meals onboard.

cards.title: Kovalam Beach
items: A rocky promontory creates a calm bay ideal for sea bathing — plus diving, parasailing and windsurfing.

sections.heading: Munnar + Thekkady + Alleppey packages.
paras: Every package includes all meals aboard the houseboat and local sightseeing across cities. Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.

maldives.title: Maldives — the sunny side of life.
maldives.lead: White sand beaches, turquoise waters, and a marine world that pulls in solo travelers, honeymooners, and families alike.

sections.heading: An utterly awe-inspiring escape into the Indian Ocean.
paras: The Maldives is an awe-inspiring destination of white sand beaches, turquoise waters, majestic islands, and startling marine life — a tranquil vacation for solo travelers, honeymooners, or families.
November through April is peak season, with the most reliable sunshine — though prices climb accordingly across accommodation and activities.

sections.heading: What to do in the Maldives.
paras: Every resort has its own version of these — we help you pick the one that fits.

cards.title: Scuba Diving
items: Some of the clearest waters in the world, with reef life right off most resort jetties.

cards.title: Sunset Fishing & Kayaking
items: Traditional fishing trips at golden hour, or a quiet kayak around the lagoon.

cards.title: Floating Breakfast
items: Breakfast served on a raft in your own private plunge pool — a Maldives signature.

cards.title: Romantic Dinner & Spa
items: Private beach dinners, couples' massages, and spa treatments overlooking the water — honeymoon essentials.

sections.heading: How to pick the perfect resort.
paras: Speedboat, domestic flight or seaplane transfers; Garden, Beach, Pool or Water Villa rooms; Breakfast-only through All-Inclusive meal plans — we match all three to your budget and trip length.

mauritius.title: Mauritius — it's a pleasure.
mauritius.lead: A volcanic island of lagoons and palm-fringed beaches, ringed by coral reefs, 2,400km off Africa's south-east coast.

sections.heading: An island known for its rare, varied flora and fauna.
paras: Mauritius is a volcanic island of lagoons and palm-fringed beaches with coral reefs surrounding most of the coastline — 1,865 square kilometers with 330km of coastline.
It was once the only known home of the dodo, which, along with several other avian species, went extinct not long after the island's settlement.

sections.heading: Things to do in Mauritius.
paras: A full-day North tour, a full-day South tour, and an island escape in between.

cards.title: Île aux Cerfs
items: A privately-owned island in Mauritius' largest lagoon — 87 hectares of preserved white-sand beaches.

cards.title: North Tour
items: Citadelle de Port-Louis, Aapravasi Ghat and Le Caudan — history and heritage in one guided day.

cards.title: South Tour
items: Trou aux Cerfs crater, the Hindu Ganga Talao temple, Chamarel Waterfalls, and the famous 7 Coloured Earths.

sections.heading: Packages across 3, 4 & 5-star hotels.
paras: Full day-by-day itinerary and hotel options shared on request.

saudi-arabia.title: Saudi Arabia — the incredible edge of the world.
saudi-arabia.lead: Rich and diverse heritage, striking landscapes, and cities that blend ultramodern skylines with centuries of history.

sections.heading: From gleaming skylines to desert legends.
paras: Ultramodern towers define Riyadh's skyline, hinting at the capital's sophisticated culture, shopping, and dining, while prayer times set the pace for daily life. Gleaming architecture blends with historic landmarks from the kingdom's earliest years.
Beyond the capital, AlUla combines legendary heritage sites — including Hegra, Saudi's first UNESCO World Heritage Site — with outdoor adventure amid dramatic desert landscapes.

sections.heading: Things to do in Saudi Arabia.
paras: Riyadh, Jeddah, and AlUla — three very different sides of the kingdom.

cards.title: Edge of the World
items: Jebel Fihrayn — a towering plateau two hours from Riyadh, with endless views and awe-inspiring silence.

cards.title: Al-Masmak Fortress
items: One of Riyadh's most historically important sites — 'Masmak' means 'strong', and local legend ties its fate to the Kingdom's.

cards.title: Al-Diriyah & At-Turaif
items: A UNESCO World Heritage Site — once one of the largest cities on the Arabian Peninsula.

cards.title: Jeddah Waterfront
items: One of the newest waterfronts in the world — a Lego-like seaside promenade perfect for a coastal stroll.

cards.title: Elephant Rock, AlUla
items: A striking geological formation rising three storeys from golden desert sands.

cards.title: Hegra, AlUla
items: Saudi Arabia's first UNESCO World Heritage Site — carved tombs dating from around the 2nd century BCE.

sections.heading: Riyadh & Jeddah packages.
paras: Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.

singapore.title: Singapore — passion made possible.
singapore.lead: A country of food, art, culture, diversity, adventure, nature and history, all in one impossibly clean city.

sections.heading: Where passion and possibilities meet.
paras: Singapore is much more than a destination. Foodies, explorers, collectors, socialisers, action seekers and cultural shapers can all experience its rich tapestry of art and culture, chase the excitement, and relish the food.
It's a country of food, art, culture, diversity, adventure, nature, and history — what more could anyone ask for?

sections.heading: Things to do in Singapore.
paras: The highlights our travelers keep coming back for.

cards.title: Gardens by the Bay
items: Over 1.5 million plants — the Flower Dome, Cloud Forest, and Supertree Grove in one place.

cards.title: Sentosa — 'State of Fun'
items: Cable cars, the Merlion Statue, Wings of Time show, S.E.A Aquarium and the Trick Eye Museum.

cards.title: Universal Studios
items: Meet Minions and Elmo, then ride Battlestar Galactica — the world's tallest duelling roller coasters.

cards.title: Night Safari
items: The world's first night zoo — a tram ride through 7 regions, home to 2,500+ animals.

cards.title: Singapore City Tour
items: Chinatown, Marina Bay, the Merlion, and Little India — history and mystery in one walk.

sections.heading: Family & couple-friendly packages.
paras: Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.

sri-lanka.title: Sri Lanka — natural, simple, adaptable.
sri-lanka.lead: An ideal winter sun destination — energetic cities, sleepy white-sand beaches, ancient temples, and dramatic scenery.

sections.heading: A tropical alternative to the cold, dark days back home.
paras: Sri Lanka is a wonderful mixture of energetic urban life, long stretches of sleepy white-sanded beaches, ancient temples, dramatic scenery and delicious food.

The island is rich in culture and covered in religious, historically significant sites — for culture lovers, the temples of Anuradhapura, a Buddhist pilgrimage site with wonderful stupas, are an absolute must.

sections.heading: Things to do in Sri Lanka.
paras: From Kandy's sacred temples to Bentota's coastline.

cards.title: Kandy Tooth Relic Temple
items: One of Sri Lankan Buddhism's most sacred sites, housing the left canine tooth relic of Lord Buddha.

cards.title: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
items: A window into rural Sri Lanka, and one of the most memorable stops on any itinerary.

cards.title: Nuwara Eliya
items: Tea estates on misty hillsides, the Ramboda Waterfall, and colonial-era British architecture.

cards.title: Sigiriya & Dambulla Cave Temple
items: A UNESCO World Heritage Site — Ravana's ancient rock palace, one of Sri Lanka's seven listed sites.

cards.title: Bentota
items: A resort town with pristine, palm-fringed beaches — great for water sports and the Kosgoda turtle hatchery.

cards.title: Colombo
items: Warm hospitality, charming weather, and the lively Pettah Floating Market.

sections.heading: Kandy + Nuwara Eliya + Bentota packages.
paras: Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.

thailand.title: Thailand — Bangkok, Pattaya, Phuket, Krabi.
thailand.lead: Beautiful beaches, an international destination that still feels wonderfully inexpensive.

sections.heading: A treasure cache of cultural attractions.
paras: Bangkok will never let you down — a city full of life, offering cultural and spiritual amenities in the same afternoon. Go from spa to resorts, shopping to partying all night, pubs to exotic Buddhist temples.
Further south, Phuket and Krabi bring tropical beaches, hidden temples, local markets and a thumping club scene — mellow in the sun, thrive at night.

sections.heading: Things to do across Thailand.
paras: Bangkok, Pattaya, Phuket, and Krabi — each with its own personality.

cards.title: Bangkok City Tour
items: Gleaming temples, a tuk tuk ride, the floating market, and delicious street food.

cards.title: Dinner Cruise, Bangkok
items: A luxurious 5-star cruise on the Chao Phraya River, dazzling in the country of smiles.

cards.title: Coral Island Tour, Pattaya
items: Parasailing, sea walking, glass-bottom boat snorkelling, jet skiing and banana boat riding.

cards.title: Phi Phi & James Bond Islands, Phuket
items: A speedboat trip around the Phi Phi archipelago, plus the island made famous by 007.

cards.title: Tiger Kingdom & Big Buddha, Phuket
items: Get up close with tigers, then visit the 148ft Big Buddha atop Nakkerad Hills.

cards.title: 4-Island & Jungle Tour, Krabi
items: Hong Island's coral reefs and sea caves, plus a 40°C hot stream waterfall in Khao Nor Chu Chi National Park.

sections.heading: Bangkok-Pattaya and Phuket-Krabi combos.
paras: Every package includes private airport transfers, temple tours, and island/coral excursions with tickets. Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.

vietnam.title: Vietnam — timeless charm.
vietnam.lead: Fascinating history, gorgeous landscapes, incredible food, and an energy that pulls you in from every angle.

sections.heading: A trip you've never quite taken before.
paras: Vietnam is arguably one of the most beautiful countries in south-eastern Asia. Its fascinating history, gorgeous landscapes, tasty food, and vibrant energy awaken all your senses at once.
The best approach: expect nothing, and let the thrill, serenity, and relaxation take over.

sections.heading: Where to go in Vietnam.
paras: Four cities, four completely different moods.

cards.title: Ho Chi Minh City
items: Formerly Saigon — vibrating with energy and traffic, the economic heart of Vietnam.

cards.title: Da Nang
items: Broad beaches, fantastic street food, and the fabled Hai Van Pass.

cards.title: Hoi An
items: Where the bold march of progress slows to a leisurely amble through the Old Town.

cards.title: Hanoi
items: Mouthwatering street food, fascinating history, and a genuinely diverse cultural mix.

cards.title: Cu Chi Tunnels
items: Part of Vietnam's extensive underground wartime network — one of Ho Chi Minh City's most iconic sights.

cards.title: Sapa & Ninh Binh
items: Rice terraces, limestone outcrops and caves — nicknamed 'Ha Long Bay on land'.

sections.heading: Hanoi, Halong Bay & Ho Chi Minh combos.
paras: Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.
